reading_rule: Compare policy type, scope and expiry across the eight documented cases.
analyst_implication: Check incentives, grid rules and building requirements before proposing a market entry.

reading_rule: Use EV sales, stock, adoption and exact-endpoint CAGR; countries and aggregates are separate.
analyst_implication: Assess demand growth alongside the existing vehicle base; sales are not charger revenue.

reading_rule: Q46 measures public-charging cost importance; IEA describes channel-dependent economics.
analyst_implication: Evaluate charging affordability and business models without assuming domestic tariffs equal public prices.

reading_rule: Use the explicitly reported country average and urban/rural context, without a world-population inference.
analyst_implication: Consider residential access and user context; the urban/rural gap is descriptive, not causal.

reading_rule: Compare four Q48 concerns across eight focus markets; keep Q46 denominators separate.
analyst_implication: Distinguish hardware need, installation access, charging time and vehicle-price barriers.

reading_rule: Use public charging points, fast-share and estimated kW per EV; retain missing components.
analyst_implication: Evaluate charging mix with home-charging context; capacity is not measured utilization or coverage.

reading_rule: Separate documented protocol functionality from real-world deployment.
analyst_implication: Consider interoperable software and smart/bidirectional integration alongside physical charging hardware.

reading_rule: Use the source as qualitative context for segment-dependent economics.
analyst_implication: Keep passenger-car conclusions separate from bus, motorcycle and battery-swapping opportunities.
